requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single functional requirement, decomposing the timing constraint into a measurable criterion.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds at the latest.

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds at the latest.
structuring_notes: The requirement is functional but contains a measurable time constraint. It is structured as a functional requirement with the timing detail captured in the measurable_criterion field.
